Class MultimapAssert<K,V>

java.lang.Object
org.assertj.core.api.AbstractAssert<MultimapAssert<K,V>, Multimap<K,V>>
be.imgn.gaia.core.testing.MultimapAssert<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the key type
V - the value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.assertj.core.api.Assert<MultimapAssert<K,V>, Multimap<K,V>>, org.assertj.core.api.Descriptable<MultimapAssert<K,V>>, org.assertj.core.api.ExtensionPoints<MultimapAssert<K,V>, Multimap<K,V>>
public final class MultimapAssert<K,V> extends org.assertj.core.api.AbstractAssert<MultimapAssert<K,V>, Multimap<K,V>>
AssertJ assertions on a Multimap. 
assertThat(scores).hasSize(3).containsKeys("alice", "bob").hasValues("alice", 3, 5).containsEntry("bob", 4);
Since:
0.1.2

    • hasValues

      @SafeVarargs public final MultimapAssert<K,V> hasValues(K key, V... values)
      Verifies that a key has exactly the given values: in this order if the values of the key are a List, as in a ListMultimap, and in any order if they are a Set, as in a SetMultimap. Giving no values verifies that the key is absent.
      Parameters:
      key - the key
      values - the expected values of key
      Returns:
      these assertions
